name: Angelic Guardian — "they" in a one-or-more-attack trigger means the attackers
notes: Found by tests/sweep.py. 'Whenever one or more creatures you control attack, they gain indestructible until end of turn.' fired to nothing: the effect text handed to the ability pseudo-permanent is just 'they gain …' and the antecedent lives in the trigger condition. _addAbilityPseudo now rewrites a leading 'they' to 'Attacking <subject of the condition>'. The attacker gains indestructible; the creature that stayed home does not.

call: they gain indestructible until end of turn.
Whenever one or more creatures you control attack, they gain indestructible until end of turn.
